[SWS_DM_01096] UDS service TransferData (0x36) upload processing
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04033
⌈
To upload data via the UDS service TransferData, the
Diagnostic Server in-
stance
shall call
ara::diag::UploadService::UploadData
to process the ser-
vice.
⌋
Besides the NRC checking according to [SWS_DM_00101] and [SWS_DM_00103] the
DM does not further service validation. All other NRC checks required by ISO 14229-
1[1] for UDS service TransferData have to be implemented in the application called in
[SWS_DM_00869] and [SWS_DM_01096].
